update.releaseNotes:
v5.8.8 - Changelog
New --- - Add 3 `Grand Live` override options to the `Scenario Overrides` page: a `Grand Live Lesson Stat Priority` for which stat gains are bought first, a `Grand Live Lesson Skill Hint Priority` that also buys ranked hints even when the running style is off-aptitude, and a `Grand Live Song Priority` that buys a ranked Song ahead of anything else learnable.
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Aston Machan 2026-08-24`. - Rank `Lessons` cards by how much each one actually grants instead of treating every card in an effect category as equal. - Show each item's effects underneath its name in the priority list pickers so you can see what you are ranking.
Fixes --- - Fix `Lessons` cards that only grant skill points being ignored because the game abbreviates the wording on them.
